name: omnilab/reactome
description: Omnilab Reactome: a pathway or a reaction by its stable identifier (R-HSA-70171) - its names, species, summary, compartments, GO biological process, Rhea reaction, inputs, outputs and catalysts, review status, release dates, DOI and diagram - its participants (UniProt proteins, ChEBI small molecules), organism, sub-events and orthologous events as related things, a search by text, and the pathways of a protein or a molecule (UniProt, ChEBI), through Reactome's Content Service, no key needed.
